newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ to buy four Kaman helicopters.
newsitem.headline: NZ to buy four Kaman helicopters.

text.p: The New Zealand government will buy four Kaman Corp Sea Sprite helicopters for the navy at a cost of more than NZ$200 million, a government source said on Tuesday.
The cabinet made the decision on Monday and the source declined to give more detail before an official announcement, expected later on Tuesday.
The choice was between Kaman's Sea Sprite and the GKN-Westland Super Lynx.
Australia and New Zealand collaborated over their selection of new navy helicopters and Australia announced its choice of the Sea Sprite in January.
Canberra said it would negotiate for 11 units with the possibility of repeat orders, pending which the value of the order was not known. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
